mainEntity.name: Should I paint interior doors myself, or is it worth hiring a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re deciding between DIY and hiring a pro, the biggest factor is finish quality versus time and risk. DIY can work for a single flat door, but paneled, damaged, or high-traffic doors usually benefit from professional prep and application. For homes in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, a local painter also helps with scheduling, on-site protection, and faster turnaround.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can be fine for a simple door, but pros are usually worth it for paneled, worn, or high-traffic doors. You get better prep, fewer defects, and less risk of sticking or visible marks.
